_comment: The intake plan. One per source. Every key except `source` is optional — include only what the source produced. `_comment` keys are ignored by the validator and should be dropped from a real plan.

source._comment: source_id is the only required field — hash, path, title, date, kind and sample are looked up from what `normalize` recorded, so nothing is transcribed by hand. Set `supersedes` only when this is a corrected re-export of a source already in the index.

new_features._comment: One self-contained functional slice. `size` is optional here — fdw-elaborate sets it properly once the spec exists.
new_features.title: Session scheduling
new_features.summary: Create sessions, place them on the agenda, and handle collisions.

signal._comment: text is English and is what the module will act on. quote is the source's own words, verbatim and untranslated — a translated quote is not evidence. All three fields are required.
signal.text: A session carries a start time and is placed on a calendar-style agenda.
signal.quote: Як зафіксовано до цього тайм-тейблу, до календарю, відповідно в тебе кожен блок мав статичну висоту.
signal.speaker: Vadim Struk

questions.text: Can two sessions occupy the same slot in one room?

merges._comment: The source discussed a feature that already exists. Append evidence rather than creating a duplicate.

signal.text: Academy reuses the events agenda almost entirely.
signal.quote: фіча Академі, вона там на 90% повторює функціонал івентів
signal.speaker: Vadim Struk

contradictions._comment: The source conflicts with what an existing feature already says. If that feature is spec-approved or later its spec is locked, and `route` MUST be "change-record" — intake never edits an approved spec.
contradictions.text: Agenda blocks must size to their content; the earlier fixed-height rule is withdrawn.
contradictions.quote: І весь контент всередині він зжовувався, розумієш?

question_closures._comment: The source answered a question the module was already carrying. The quote must be the words that answered it.
question_closures.answer: Events feedback ships before Academy starts.
question_closures.quote: логічно мені спочатку реалізувати цей фідбек по івентах, а потім вже на основі нього будувати цей Академі

glossary._comment: Canonical term plus the mangled or foreign variants seen in sources. This is what keeps a Ukrainian call, an English WBS and a legacy PRD talking about the same thing.
glossary.definition: The per-feature elaboration document produced by fdw-elaborate.

deferred.title: Certification tracking
deferred.reason: Client confirmed it is out of scope until Academy ships.

decisions: Sliced Academy apart from Events despite 90% overlap — they ship in different phases and Academy depends on Events feedback landing first.
